_comment: Sovereign-mesh node/capability registry. DECLARATIVE source of truth for capability-routed federation (research-review docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-29-research-review-sovereign-mesh-two-nas-replication-federation.md). The job router selects the node whose declared `caps` is a superset of a job's `requires`, health-green, cheapest/closest first. DECLARED, NOT GUESSED (DR-0061 reality-trace) and DETERMINISTIC (no LLM in the dispatch decision; the LLM is only the worker on the chosen node). Generalizes the vendor-axis picker in scripts/wake-router.mjs + DR-0073 to a node axis. SHIPS INERT: editing this file does not arm anything; routing still passes through the per-node Cage brakes (infra/ai-orchestrator/portable/orchestrator/lib/brakes.sh) and the mesh kill-switch. Values marked SME-CONFIRM are flagged for Darrell/BG (church hardware, GPU-endpoint IP, church NAS access) per the research-review section 6 — DO NOT fabricate; an SME-CONFIRM cap is treated as OFFLINE by the router until a real value lands.

mesh_kill_switch.note: registry-side mesh-wide kill-switch; UNREACHABLE = treated as ENGAGED (fail closed)

nodes.notes: Verified: Xeon D-1527 4c/8t CPU-only, 32 GB ECC, dual 10 GbE. Runs Caddy poetech-web, n8n, Ollama (CPU), self-hosted Supabase compose. The single authoritative registry/ledger lives here.

nodes.role: gpu worker (voice clone / whisper transcription / local 14B LLM)
nodes.notes: SME-CONFIRM: the 2x RTX 4070 live in companion CUDA/Windows box(es) on the church LAN, NOT in the Synology NAS. Needs Tailscale IP(s) + Ubuntu/CUDA/Docker/Ollama + the whisper endpoint (infra/church-gpu-node/whisper-gpu/) joined to the tailnet. NOT on the mesh as of 2026-06-10 probe. Passive endpoint; brakes live on the caller.

SME-CONFIRM: tlcrackstation (Synology RackStation). On the tailnet but fully firewalled (22/5000/5001/5678/11434/443 filtered, 2026-06-10). Holds the ~100 TB recording corpus (node-local by nature, referenced by ID). Access = a credential/his-hand step (Darrell/BG).
